section.title: Validate Each File Before a Commit
section.p: To validate each file automatically before a commit, select the Validate each file before committing option in the Git Client Preferences page.

If validation problems are detected, the commit operation stops and a dialog box states that you can view the problems in the Git pre-commit validation tab of the Results area. If the Allow commit despite validation problems option is selected, the dialog box includes a Commit anyway button.

section.title: Validate Before a Push Operation
section.p: To validate files from the Main Files folder automatically before a push operation, select the Validate all files from the project's "Main Files" folder before pushing option in the Git Client Preferences page.

For this option to work, Main Files support must be enabled and the files must be added to the Main Files folder. A validation scenario must also be configured because the validation is based on it. The current repository must be the same as the project loaded in the Project view and there must be no uncommitted changes. If uncommitted changes are detected, a dialog box offers to create a stash that is applied after project validation.

If validation problems are detected, the push operation stops and a dialog box states that you can view the problems in the Git pre-push validation tab of the Results area. If the Allow push despite validation problems option is selected, the dialog box includes a Push anyway button.
